proposal.summary: A vulnerability in libcap's pthread_create() may allow a malicious actor to cause __real_pthread_create() to return an error, which can exhaust process memory.
proposal.cwe_quote: which can exhaust the process memory.

AV.quote: may allow a malicious actor to use cause __real_pthread_create() to return an error

A.quote: which can exhaust the process memory.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Triage and reproduce the issue to identify affected libcap versions and triggers; implement input/return-value validation around pthread_create/__real_pthread_create and add resource limits or allocation failure handling to prevent memory exhaustion.

evidence_quotes.quote: A vulnerability was found in the pthread_create() function in libcap.
This issue may allow a malicious actor to use cause __real_pthread_create() to return an error, which can exhaust the process memory.
